default_compatibility.collector_ast: Independent AST specialization removes only the two new policy assertions, specializes the own/c1 query/future branches to c1, and restores the previously implicit identity constructor default. The complete resulting collect_batch AST equals the baseline function. Query proposals, masks, C1 continuation batching, labels, wrong-update denominator and sampling logic are unchanged on this path.
default_compatibility.tracker_ast: Only accept_observation was added as a method. All five other pre-existing non-step methods are AST-identical. Inlining the helper into step, restoring the prior-template/source diagnostic reads to their original positions, and restoring independent statistics-update ordering yields the exact old step AST.
default_compatibility.diagnostic_reordering: Both versions compute target_source_indices from pre-commit identity memory and the current output descriptors. The moved reads consume no state changed by the preceding old descriptor/gate calculations. Prior template frame/box is still captured before query commit. Changed-candidate counters and max-history/pending counters preserve their values on successful execution.
default_compatibility.metadata: New future_policy_mode and prefix_write_verification values are intentionally recorded. Config JSON bytes are therefore not expected to equal old config files. The requirement is unchanged default decision arrays, labels, trajectories and diagnostics, which must still be demonstrated on real NN execution.
default_compatibility.schema: No neural module, parameter tensor, checkpoint state_dict, action utility or trainable loss mathematics changed. Trainer and evaluator have exactly one metadata string edit each; independent AST normalization of those strings reproduces their complete baseline ASTs.
default_compatibility.actual_parity: Main-agent state v3 actual receipt establishes old/new default learned identity-prefix C1-future arrays and complete old/new action/identity tracking on both full videos. Pure prefix_model=None remains covered by exact specialized source AST equality; that unchanged path is not used by this matched full collection.

own_query_commit.precondition: own future requires an explicitly supplied prefix_model both at CLI and collect_batch level. The prefix model and motion module are loaded strictly, frozen and set to eval. The chosen prefix write-verification mode is explicitly applied to the tracker and consequently to its future step calls.
own_query_commit.parent: A learned prefix context updates context.branch=tracker.branch after every prefix frame. At query1 both refer to the initial branch. Therefore the shallow-copied shadow.branch used by accept_observation is the same actual pre-query parent as context.branch.
own_query_commit.time: Prefix execution stops at query-1. Each action shadow is assigned frame=query; accept_observation does not increment frame. It commits the query box and records history at query. The following three shadow.step calls advance exactly to query+1, query+2 and query+3.
own_query_commit.actions: Every valid candidate receives regular action; pause is enumerated only when raw confidence>.84. Each query action is deliberately forced before following the frozen future policy. It is not reselected using GT or constrained to the teacher's preferred current action.
own_query_commit.state_commit: The shared helper invokes the existing _advance for box/provider/template state, rolls back template/mask/pending entries for a query pause, applies the same verified identity-memory commit and context-slot updates, updates motion memory using actual write, appends selected box/frame/quality to bounded history, and replaces branch/branches. This includes real context-memory updates even when target/template writing is paused.
own_query_commit.query_wrong_update: Initial wrong_updates uses writes AND not pause AND currentIoU<.2, which is the same actual query write condition returned by this helper. It does not read a stale prefix last_decision.

branch_isolation.private_mutables: Each action copies the stats dict and creates its own history deque with maxlen8. _advance calls Branch.copy, which copies box/search_box arrays and pending/scores/boxes deques; newly committed boxes are copied. Existing history entry arrays and pending template tensors are read rather than modified in place.
branch_isolation.tensor_states: InstanceMemory.update and DiscriminativeMemory.update return new tensors. Assigning shadow.identity_memory and shadow.motion_memory does not mutate the parent's or sibling's tensor storage. Query template creation normalizes a newly allocated divided crop, and pauses reuse the unchanged parent template/mask.
branch_isolation.other_aliases: branch/branches, template-source metadata, last_observation and last_decision are replaced on the shadow. The shared frozen modules and anchors are read-only. The cropping provider copies the input bbox into its own cached_bbox. No parent deque is appended through a shadow.
branch_isolation.shared_extractor_mode: The extractor's proposal_policy is shared mutable configuration, but future branches execute serially, each step starts with peaks, and extra_observation restores peaks. Query dense proposals also restore peaks before future work. There is no concurrent branch execution in this code.
branch_isolation.verification_needed: Satisfied by actual v3 parent/sibling state comparisons and all-action shadow history/stats isolation. Reverse replay covers jobs only, correctly named in the receipt; no within-query action-order reversal claim is made.

future_causality_and_labels.query_inputs: All query decision arrays and predicted-prefix history arrays are copied before future images or later GT are decoded. The new own branch occurs only after these copies. The future policy receives images and its actual predicted state through shadow.step, never GT arrays.
future_causality_and_labels.future_execution: Each of three future frames calls the complete RecoverabilityTracker.step, including the actual optional one-extra-region visual search, learned candidate/regular/pause selection, and deployed template, identity-memory, motion-memory and history updates. It is not an original-only C1 observe_actions continuation.
future_causality_and_labels.future_wrong_writes: Wrong-update accumulation uses bool(shadow.last_decision['template_updated']) after that frame's step together with offline IoU<.2. A high raw score whose actual write was paused is not counted as a write. The unchanged four-frame query-plus-three-future denominator remains4.
future_causality_and_labels.GT_scope: GT selects eligible offline supervision jobs and supplies current/history/future labels only. Query candidate choice enumeration and future online decisions do not receive those labels. motion_targets remains a label field, not a decision input.
future_causality_and_labels.teacher_scope: own means the supplied frozen ABC checkpoint, with its configured verification mode, continues for three causal steps. It does not mean the subsequently trained student updates the teacher online, nor does it establish long-horizon on-policy performance.
future_causality_and_labels.utility_scope: Existing action_utility and immediate search-cost accounting are unchanged. The own continuation may execute additional future searches; no claim is made that existing query-only extra-crop receipt fields count those future visual calls.

statistics_and_diagnostics.step: Actual v3 old/new checks passed1238transitions for each tracker over two full videos x two verification modes, including every last_decision field, core state and statistics. Latency was excluded. Query helper, actual future frame/GT/write reconstruction and parent/sibling checks also passed.
statistics_and_diagnostics.forced_query: accept_observation returns branch/write/memory_rates/verified but does not create a synthetic query last_decision or increment changed_candidate_indices for a forced counterfactual. Neither is used for labels or serialized prefix counters. Prefix counters are copied before forking. Future step overwrites last_decision before it is read for wrong-update labels.
statistics_and_diagnostics.receipt: future_policy_mode, prefix checkpoint/mode, own future checkpoint epoch and serial future-execution description make the new teacher explicit. Samples keep the existing schema; config provenance distinguishes the teacher.

matched_experiment_requirements: Collect C1-future and own-future labels from identical jobs, prefix checkpoint, prefix write-verification mode, collector batch settings and query candidate generation. Verify all pre-future decision arrays and action masks are identical before treating this as a teacher-only comparison.

Explicitly use action verification on both matched arms if continuing the current action-mode policy. A new own/action cache versus old identity-prefix or mixed-prefix caches changes more than the future teacher.

Own teacher requires a learned prefix tracker. Recollect the matched C1-future control with that same prefix tracker instead of substituting old C1-prefix inputs and calling the comparison single-factor.

The computationally unchanged trainer asserts a common future_policy string across its TRAIN and VAL source configs. Do not mix C1-future and own-future roots inside one fit or silently remove that check; each arm needs consistently labeled TRAIN and validation data.

C1 future retains its historical batched implementation while own future executes deployed serial steps. Record those execution settings; finite-precision label differences alone do not establish a learned-policy improvement.

initial_m0_checklist: On isolated source, compare old/new deployed tracker boxes, every diagnostic array and statistics at fixed weights on real videos. Cover action and identity modes and actually observed regular writes, pauses, memory commits and extra-search behavior; compare deterministic arrays exactly while excluding latency.

Compare old/new default C1 collector output arrays and labels on the same real jobs, including a frozen-C1 prefix and a learned identity-mode prefix. Expected config additions are metadata, not trajectory differences.

For matched new c1/own future modes, assert identical query/prefix arrays and action_valid masks before any future decode. Include a query1 case, a history-full case and a query whose pending template entries expire within the tested horizon.

Force real observed regular and pause actions for the same high-confidence candidate, a non-writable regular candidate, and a valid extra-region candidate. Compare query template/mask, bounded memory states, branch box/provider and history against the same deployed commit rules.

After one fork commits and advances, verify the original parent and an untouched sibling tensor/array/deque contents remain unchanged. Reversing jobs must reproduce each row. Do not describe this as reversing per-query action enumeration.

Record each own shadow's future frame numbers query+1..query+3, actual selected box/search/pause/template_updated, and recompute future_iou and wrong_update_fraction against GT. Explicitly verify a future pause does not count as a wrong write merely because raw>.84.

Keep the four running production evaluations on their original sources. M0 must use a private source path and distinct outputs; production deployment remains pending successful real parity/state witnesses and an appropriate non-live source transition.
